provenance: retrospective, post hoc diagnostic from stored outputs (coauthor review R2); no learner, candidate evaluation or optimizer campaign; the alternative fits replace nothing

evaluation_set.description: predictions of the two fits are compared on the 78 external audit points, the 79 distinct design points and 4096 points drawn uniformly from the coded box with a fixed seed

criteria.term_stable: symmetric difference of the selected term sets <= 2 terms
criteria.prediction_stable: RMS prediction difference over the evaluation set <= 0.25 x the external RMSE of the 88-row fit, AND Spearman between the two fits' predictions over the evaluation set >= 0.99
criteria.anchor_changed: the coded location of the objective's surrogate minimizer moves by more than 0.10 x the coded box diagonal (2 sqrt(7)), OR any payoff-matrix entry changes by more than 0.10 objective units
criteria.factor_low: same cost-factor assignment and orientation, min |Tucker| >= 0.95 over the three matched factors, |change in either quality weight| <= 0.05, and Spearman >= 0.99 between the frozen and alternative values of each objective on the 79 distinct pilot configurations and on the pooled stored external audit rows
criteria.factor_high: cost-factor assignment or orientation changes, or min |Tucker| < 0.85, or Spearman < 0.90 for either objective on either row set
criteria.dataset_high: factor_high; OR a gate decision flips in >= 10 of 30 replications for either objective; OR the anchors change (anchor_changed) in more than 15 of 30 replications for either objective
criteria.dataset_moderate: not high, and any of: factor model not factor_low; more than 3 of 30 fits not term_stable or not prediction_stable for either objective; any gate flip; anchors change in more than 3 of 30 replications for either objective
